# Préparation du traitement
Installation des librairies et importation des données
```{r, setup, results='hide', message=FALSE}
source("support/preparation.R")

library(questionr)
library(survey)
library(gtsummary)
library(forestmodel)
```

```{r}
menages_people_count <- menages %>%
  full_join(individus, by = c("NQUEST")) %>%
  group_by(NQUEST) %>%
  summarise(
    adult_count = sum(AGE >= 18),
    children_count = sum(TRAGE %in% c(0, 1)),
    employed_count = sum(OCCP %in% c(1, 2)),
    older_than_or_14_years_old_count = sum(AGE >= 14),
    others_older_than_or_14_years_old_count = older_than_or_14_years_old_count - 1,
    lower_than_14_years_old_count = sum(AGE < 14),
    lower_than_10_years_old_count = sum(AGE < 10)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    UC = 1,
    UC = UC + (others_older_than_or_14_years_old_count * 0.5),
    UC = UC + (lower_than_14_years_old_count * 0.3)
  ) %>%
  select(-older_than_or_14_years_old_count, -others_older_than_or_14_years_old_count, -lower_than_14_years_old_count)
menages <- menages %>%
  full_join(menages_people_count, by = c("NQUEST"))
```

<!-- # Modèle logistique BINAIRE -->

<!-- ```{r, child=c('logistique.Rmd')} -->

```{r}
rev_tps <- deplacements %>%
  group_by(NQUEST, NP) %>%
  summarise(temps = sum(DUREE)) %>%
  right_join(individus, by = c("NQUEST", "NP")) %>%
  mutate(temps = tidyr::replace_na(temps, 0)) %>%
  left_join(menages, by = c("NQUEST")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CS8))

ggplot(rev_tps, aes(x = temps, y = REVENU)) +
  geom_point()
```


```{r}
rev_tps <- deplacements %>%
  group_by(NQUEST, NP) %>%
  summarise(temps = sum(DUREE)) %>%
  right_join(individus, by = c("NQUEST", "NP")) %>%
  mutate(temps = replace_na(temps, 0)) %>%
  left_join(menages, by = c("NQUEST")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CS8), CS8 == 5, CS8 == 6)

ggplot(rev_tps, aes(x = temps, y = REVMEN)) +
  geom_point()
```
